summary: M8 Phase 1: Project Structure & Safety — Implement multi-document project management (F-001) with Project→Volume→Chapter hierarchy, filesystem persistence via Tauri FS plugin, and version history (F-002) with full content snapshots and diff viewer
approach: Three-wave execution. Wave 1 establishes the data model (ProjectSlice) and filesystem persistence layer in parallel. Wave 2 integrates them with data migration from localStorage, builds the sidebar tree UI, and wires the editor to load/save from the project filesystem. Wave 3 adds version snapshots and the history rail UI. Metadata stored as JSON files via Tauri FS plugin (SQLite deferred to future optimization).

waves.label: Foundation
waves.rationale: Data model and persistence layer have no mutual dependencies and form the foundation for all subsequent tasks

waves.label: Integration
waves.rationale: Migration, sidebar, and editor integration all depend on Wave 1 but can proceed in parallel with each other

waves.label: Version History
waves.rationale: Version snapshots depend on editor integration (TASK-005) for save triggers; history rail depends on snapshot storage

data_flow.storage: TipTap JSON files at {appDataDir}/projects/{projectId}/chapters/{chapterId}.json via Tauri FS plugin
data_flow.migration: localStorage → filesystem with backup, plain text → TipTap JSON conversion

design_decisions.decision: Filesystem JSON for project metadata instead of gateway SQLite
design_decisions.rationale: Simpler implementation, avoids cross-directory changes to src-ts/mcp/, all operations via Tauri FS plugin. SQLite optimization deferred to future phase when query complexity warrants it.
design_decisions.impact: Eliminates dependency on gateway for metadata, reduces scope

design_decisions.decision: Direct Tauri FS plugin usage (no custom Rust IPC commands)
design_decisions.rationale: tauri_plugin_fs already loaded, provides all needed file I/O. Custom IPC commands only needed for operations the plugin can't handle.
design_decisions.impact: Simpler architecture, no Rust changes needed for file operations

design_decisions.decision: Custom tree component (not headless UI library)
design_decisions.rationale: Matches existing codebase patterns (all components are hand-built TailwindCSS). Consistent styling, no new dependency.
design_decisions.impact: More implementation effort for tree, but consistent with codebase

design_decisions.rationale: Short, URL-safe, matches existing simplicity preference. Better than Date.now() but not as heavy as UUID.
design_decisions.impact: New dependency (nanoid), but widely used and tiny

patterns: Zustand slice pattern: interface + create function + spread into store
Tauri FS plugin: import from @tauri-apps/plugin-fs, use readFile/writeFile/mkdir/exists
Component pattern: TailwindCSS classes, no CSS modules, no UI library
Store composition: AppState = Slice1 & Slice2 & ... via intersection type
dependencies: diff (new — for Myers diff in TASK-007)
